title: What if all colleges merged into one campus?
narrator: Deadpan documentary: calm and dry, treats the impossible premise like a serious report. The jokes land through understatement.
logline: Every college slides into one spot. The walk to class takes all day and orientation lasts a semester.

cues.onScreen: What if all colleges became one campus?
cues.narration: What if all colleges became one campus?
Thousands of colleges. Thousands of fight songs.

cues.onScreen: Each has its own buildings and traditions.
cues.narration: Each with its own buildings, mascot, and very specific traditions.

cues.onScreen: Then every campus starts moving to one spot.
cues.narration: Then they all start moving toward one spot.

cues.onScreen: Every campus slides toward the middle of the map.
cues.narration: From every state, campuses slide toward the middle of the map. Nobody checked the zoning.
And they squeeze together. Gently. Then not gently.
cues.delivery: Slight wince on the last phrase.

cues.onScreen: Problem 1: The walk to class takes all day.
cues.narration: Monday: your next class is on the other side of campus. Leave yesterday.

cues.onScreen: Problem 2: Every mascot shows up to one game.
cues.narration: Game day: every mascot shows up. The mascot committee is still arguing.

cues.onScreen: Problem 3: The dining hall line never ends.
cues.narration: Lunch: one dining hall. The line has its own zip code.
So they build one mega-campus. Orientation lasts a semester.

cues.onScreen: Every landmark. One very crowded campus.
cues.narration: Every landmark. One very crowded map.

cues.onScreen: Which landmark would you visit first?
cues.narration: Which landmark would you visit first?
